**BLUF:** Russian overnight missile and drone barrages struck Ukraine (killing at least nine, damaging three Kyiv bridges) with spillover of two Kh-101 cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone into Polish airspace during allied exercises; Polish PM Tusk called it a likely deliberate provocation and NATO condemned it as a grave violation. Houthi ballistic missiles targeted Riyadh (intercepted by Saudi coalition air defenses) and a tanker was struck by projectile in the Strait of Hormuz (fire reported, no casualties per UKMTO). Ukrainian strikes caused visible damage to the Kerch Bridge; chatter confirms coordinated Ukrainian systems (Neptune, Flamingo, etc.). CISA added multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog. Most other theatres remained quiet in the window.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Multiple accounts, including @heyday_news and @WCLNews247 (21 Nov ~03:50-03:55 UTC), reported Russian overnight strikes killing at least nine in Ukraine (seven in Kyiv, two in Lviv), damaging three Kyiv bridges, and forcing nuclear plants to reduce output due to grid damage; Zelenskyy cited >400 drones and >110 missiles including 27 ballistic.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @kakkamax and @AMK_Mapping_ (21 Nov ~03:49-03:55 UTC) highlighted visible damage to the Kerch Bridge from Ukrainian strikes using multiple systems (Dovbush, Vendetta, Neptune, Flamingo, etc.), with claims of over 16 hits; one post referenced satellite imagery challenges due to radar noise.[[2]](https://x.com/kakkamax/status/2123988650228957554)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @farazmanzil and @IranPress_eng (21 Nov ~03:42-03:54 UTC) noted a tanker struck by unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz near Khasab, catching fire (UKMTO); IRGC claimed mine strike or downing of US MQ-9 drone (unverified in posts).[[3]](https://x.com/farazmanzil/status/2123988405029622138)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @englishpardafas and @sadashifukuda (21 Nov ~03:51-03:54 UTC) reported Saudi coalition intercepting three Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh, with prior alerts and power issues in affected areas.[[4]](https://x.com/englishpardafas/status/2123988402681102453)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] @KhaosodEnglish and @SouthAfricansP1 (21 Nov ~03:40-03:51 UTC) covered two Russian missiles and a jet drone entering Polish airspace and crashing in southeast Poland (locations: Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik nad Sanem, Mołodycz); Tusk described it as likely provocation during European drills near the sites.[[5]](https://x.com/KhaosodEnglish/status/2123987342360997934)

searched: Kyiv strike; Kerch Bridge; Hormuz tanker; Riyadh Houthi; Poland missile

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (20-21 Nov) reported Russian mass missile/drone attack on Kyiv after midnight 20 Nov, striking three bridges, killing at least nine, and causing widespread power/water disruption; Zelenskyy warned the Crimean Bridge “will not stay.”[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

[OSINT - WEB] Multiple outlets including AP, Guardian, and BBC (20-21 Nov) confirmed Ukrainian Neptune missiles, drones, and Flamingo cruise missiles struck the Kerch Bridge, with visible damage; Polish officials reported three Russian objects (Kh-101 missile, another likely missile, jet-powered drone) entered Polish airspace and crashed in SE Poland during the barrage.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

[OSINT - WEB] Reuters and others (19-21 Nov) noted Putin vowed a “much more painful” response after the bridge strike; Tusk called the Poland incursion a likely deliberate provocation, with NATO’s Rutte condemning it as a grave violation.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

**Assessment:** The spillover into NATO airspace during allied exercises near the impact sites raises the risk of miscalculation or escalation, though no Article 4 invocation has occurred yet; Ukrainian deep strikes on the bridge demonstrate sustained capability. Likely (moderate confidence, based on multiple independent wire reports and official statements).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Reuters, The National, Arab News, and gCaptain (19-20 Nov) reported Houthi missile strike damaged Riyadh’s PIF Tower (tallest skyscraper and sovereign wealth fund HQ), with several injuries; Saudi coalition intercepted three additional Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Riyadh.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain and Arab News (20 Nov) reported another tanker struck by projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, catching fire with no casualties; UKMTO issued warning.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye (21 Nov) noted IRGC claim of intercepting US MQ-9 drone over Hormuz.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

**Assessment:** Houthi reach on Riyadh and repeated Hormuz incidents widen the conflict beyond Red Sea shipping, pressuring Gulf stability and any US-Iran diplomacy; escalation risk remains elevated. Likely (moderate confidence, corroborated across Saudi, UKMTO, and Iranian statements).

### INDO-PACIFIC
Quiet in window. No new headlines or chatter indicating movement beyond prior Russian Tu-95 ADIZ transit already noted.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA KEV (18-20 Nov) added multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities including Synology DSM, BerriAI LiteLLM, REDCap, Apache Axis, and others.[[1]](https://x.com/heyday_news/status/2123988159088275640)

searched: CISA KEV headlines; no significant new X chatter on active exploitation.

**Assessment:** Active exploitation of listed CVEs continues; organizations should prioritize patching. Likely (high confidence, direct from official CISA catalog).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

searched: US bank outage; FAA ground stop.

**Assessment:** No new major incidents; prior disruptions appear contained. Unlikely (moderate confidence, absence of fresh reporting).

## 5. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window. No official statements or releases.

**Assessment:** No developments. 

## 6. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window. No peer-reviewed releases or programme announcements.

**Assessment:** No developments.

## FORECAST CHECK
1. TRIGGERED - Ukrainian strikes caused visible damage to Kerch Bridge rail/span sections, reported via local accounts and consistent with prior Ukrainian claims.
2. OPEN - Additional Hormuz tanker incident occurred but without reported spill/sinking or major new UKMTO advisory beyond the existing warning.
3. OPEN - Poland and NATO strongly condemned the airspace violation but no Article 4 invocation or enhanced deployments announced.
4. TRIGGERED - Saudi coalition intercepted three Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh, with Houthi claims and Saudi civil defence activity confirming further strikes.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- NATO Article 4 consultation or Polish request for enhanced air policing -> formal alliance response to Russian spillover -> first on NATO/Polish MoD statements -> roughly even chance in 48h.
- Fifth+ Hormuz incident with spill or major shipping advisory -> supertanker rates/insurance spike -> first on Lloyd’s/UKMTO notices -> unlikely in 48h.
- Ukrainian General Staff confirmation of additional Kerch Bridge rail damage or Black Sea Fleet hits -> sustained deep-strike campaign -> first on official Ukrainian statements -> likely in 48h.
- Houthi claim or Saudi report of successful Riyadh strike beyond interceptions -> Yemen theatre escalation -> first on Houthi statements or Saudi civil defence -> likely in 48h.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of exact Polish crash sites and any debris analysis remains limited to official statements.
- Full casualty and damage reconciliation from the Ukrainian strikes is preliminary.
- No open-source verification of IRGC MQ-9 claim or exact Hormuz projectile type.

sections.Solar Activity: Past 24 h: Solar activity was at low levels in the past 24h. There are 5 active regions on the visible solar disk. The largest Region 4579 (N16W09, Hsx/alpha) was responsible for the largest flare of the period: a C9.6 flare that peaked at 20/1130 UTC. The most magnetically complex Region 4581 (S07E25, Dao/beta) continued quiet, as its intermediary spots decayed and reorganized. The remaining regions showed some decay as they rotated towards the west limb. A filament that erupted near Region 4579 in the previous reported period, around 19/0730 UTC, was associated with a faint CME (poorly detected by the available coronagraphs). Analysis suggest a glancing blow near-Earth on Nov 23, that might create a combined effect with the anticipated arrival of a CME from 14 Nov. sections.Solar Wind: Past 24 h: Solar wind parameters reflected undisturbed conditions near Earth in the past 24h. Solar wind speeds continued gradually decreasing, from 400 km/s down to 350 km/s levels. Phi was positive through the whole reported period.
